text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: *pant*, *pant*, *gasp*...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (—I can hear the cheers.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(I ran. On my own legs, across the turf of 
the Twinkle Series...)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (My story has begun!)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer!
choice_data_list: Welcome back! You did great out there!
Welcome back! You did such a great job!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I... I—um...! There's just so much I 
want to talk about!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Once we get back to the academy... could 
you spare me a little bit of your time...?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, so suddenly...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to consult with her about our 
future rotation as well, so I'm glad we 
could have this discussion.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However... why the library, instead of the 
train on the way home or the Trainer's 
office? And furthermore—
choice_data_list: What on earth is this mountain of books?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes. Well, this is...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For some reason, a mountain of novels was 
piled high on the desk in front of Zenno 
Rob Roy.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
These are my recommended "classic 
adventure novels"!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
For instance, this one is a classic 
rags-to-riches tale, but the narration is 
delightfully breezy.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"That's a classic 'rescue the princess' 
game where the heroine constantly gets 
kidnapped, but the brilliance of its 
world-building is truly astounding."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
And this one is what you'd call a 'search 
for the missing father' type—
choice_data_list:
How does this connect to Rob Roy's 
story...?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, um... what I mean is, classic, 
royal-road storylines are beloved by so 
many people, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Next time it'll surely turn out like this, 
this protagonist will surely do this for 
us—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
“Sticking to the royal road” gives readers 
a sense of reassurance and excitement.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: So, umm—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Ugh, that kinda sounded like an excuse... 
Just say it, say it...)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: —I want to walk the royal road.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: T-The Classic Triple Crown route, please!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
The Satsuki Sho, the Japanese Derby, the 
Kikuka Sho— Especially the Derby... I want 
to run in it no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Um... if you ask me whether I was 
influenced by Kris S-san's Derby, I can't 
really deny it, but...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Still, the Derby is... The story called 
the "Japanese Derby" is...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
“—I've been yearning for this since a 
long, long time ago too...!”

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"So, I thought and thought... Wondering if 
even the heroes in novels—"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"—With the presence of real-life heroes 
giving me a push forward as well."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"The hero I aspire to be surely lies at 
the end of the royal road... I want to win 
the Triple Crown—the Derby. That's what I 
thought."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...In the first place, given her 
aptitudes, aiming for the Classic Triple 
Crown from here is only natural."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It was a situation where a glaringly 
obvious fact was stated with a bit of 
exaggeration. However—"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Eh, ah, yes...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few months ago, she was afraid to even 
speak of her dreams, yet now she put her 
resolve into words.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We should figure out her rotation right 
away. Her body isn't fully conditioned 
yet, so perhaps we should stick to a 
break-in period for a while...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: A test run, huh...
choice_data_list:
It's all so you can make a huge splash 
next year.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...I see... You're really giving this some 
serious thought...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Somehow, the tension just drained out 
of me. I guess I was worrying over 
nothing.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
To think a plain Uma Musume like me... 
could take the "royal road." I wondered if 
people would laugh at me...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Thinking about that, I brought a whole 
bunch of novels with me, hoping to show at 
least a bit of how serious I am.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Still, yeah. That worry was completely 
uncalled for."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
—This single volume was more than enough, 
wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Now then, what shall we do about 
the rotation?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her debut race concluded without incident. 
For now, let's enter races at Zenno Rob 
Roy's own pace and steadily build up her 
experience.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Peeking into the notebook together, we 
turn to a new page. —Chapter One is off to 
a great start!
